./venv/bin/python << 'EOF' 2>/dev/null
import os
for k in list(os.environ):
    if k.lower().startswith('no') and 'prox' in k.lower():
        del os.environ[k]
import hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()

# 1. Upload the script
ds = project.get_dataset_api()
path = ds.upload("data/failing_job.py", "Resources", overwrite=True)
print("uploaded:", path)

# 2. Create the job
ja = project.get_job_api()
conf = ja.get_configuration("PYTHON")
conf["appPath"] = "/Projects/" + project.name + "/Resources/failing_job.py"
job = ja.create_job("flaky190953", conf)
print("job created:", job.name)

# 3. Alert receiver + job-failure alert
aa = project.get_alerts_api()
receiver_name = "flaky190953-failure-alert"
try:
    rec = aa.create_alert_receiver(receiver_name, email_configs=[{"to": "oncall-flaky190953@example.com"}])
    print("receiver created:", rec.name)
except Exception as e:
    print("email receiver failed:", e)
    try:
        rec = aa.create_alert_receiver(receiver_name, webhook_configs=[{"url": "https://example.com/hooks/flaky190953"}])
        print("webhook receiver created:", rec.name)
    except Exception as e2:
        print("webhook receiver failed:", e2)
        rec = None

alert = aa.create_job_alert(job_name="flaky190953", receiver=receiver_name, status="failed", severity="critical")
print("alert created:", alert)
EOF
tool_input.description: Upload script, create job flaky190953, create failure alert
